title: Recruited into the GTE program and combat control
place_text: US Air Force; Lackland Air Force Base, Texas

tellings.quote: Yeah, so I ended up getting recruited to a brand new program that was called GTE,

plain: Jake Barber, who later says he flew helicopters to recover unidentified craft, says that in 1994 he was recruited into a brand new US Air Force program he calls GTE, without spelling out the name. He says it led him to Lackland Air Force Base in Texas and into combat control, an Air Force special operations field, as the start of the career behind his later claims.
